also.quote: At this time, we are not able to consider international applicants’ requests for fee waivers on the basis of financial hardship.

english_waiver.value: Automatic exemption only for undergraduate degrees from Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or US; English-medium degrees from other countries (e.g. India) explicitly do not qualify. Physics says a department waiver "may be available" (discretionary, requested in the application).
english_waiver.quote: Graduate Admissions does not consider the following to be circumstances eligible for an exemption: | You received an undergraduate degree from an institution where the Medium of Instruction was in English in a country that is not listed above.

also.quote: Department ELP policy: A waiver of TOEFL/IELTS may be available for eligible applicants.

notes: physics.mit.edu blocked automated fetches (403, also with a headless browser), so facts come from the MIT Office of Graduate Education program page. OGE grants up to three fee waivers per applicant.
